title: Decolonial AI Alignment: Openness, Viśeṣa-Dharma, and Including Excluded Knowledges

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical and philosophical critique of existing LLM alignment practices (e.g., RLHF, Constitutional AI) to evaluate Western-centric moral absolutism and coloniality of knowledge. The paper does not empirically measure bias in model outputs, but rather conceptually evaluates how current alignment paradigms exclude non-Western epistemologies and proposes a decolonial architecture using parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA) for cultural adaptation.
